title: torch.nn.utils.rnn.pack_padded_sequence segment fault if not in decreasing order

labels.name: module: crash
labels.description: Problem manifests as a hard crash, as opposed to a RuntimeError

body:
## 🐛 Bug

Instead of raising an exception, the function `torch.nn.utils.rnn.pack_padded_sequence` forces python environment to shut down due to a segmentation fault if the input is not in decreasing order.


## To Reproduce

```python 
import torch
from torch.nn.utils.rnn import pad_sequence, pack_padded_sequence
a = torch.ones(25, 300)
b = torch.ones(22, 300)
b_a = pad_sequence([b, a])
pack_padded_sequence(b_a, [22, 25])
>>> 31906 abort (core dumped)  ipython
a_b = pad_sequence([a, b])
pack_padded_sequence(a_b, [25, 22]) # it works!
```

## Expected behavior

Should return an exception instead of a segmentation fault
